title: Fixing Elision Ambiguity
goal: Disambiguate return lifetime when elision rule two fails due to multiple inputs.
hints: Declare 'a on the function and apply it to target.
explanation: With two input references, elision rule two cannot decide which parameter is returned, so returning `&'a str` requires declaring `<'a>` and binding `target: &'a str`. Leaving `<'a>` off produces undeclared lifetime error `E0261`. Leaving `target` as `&str` causes lifetime mismatch `E0621` because `target` gets an anonymous lifetime separate from `'a`. Passing `String` causes type mismatch `E0308`.
